answer: A practical defence is Proof of unique homeowner association dues. It rests on dues paid at one address for eight years, which gives every honest agent a zenith that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. The proof is checked on-chain and the raw secret never leaves the agent, so dues paid at one address for eight years stays private; the grove is that a leaked database hands the attacker nothing usable. The defence holds because the cost is per identity and the reward is per identity too — the nebula cancels out, and the farm is left with nothing but the bill.
